title: Answer: measurement is the gravitational clustering of trajectories

statements.text: Measurement is the nonlinear convergence of state-space trajectories into a finite number of clusters, an inherently gravitational process in line with Penrose's gravitationally induced collapse. There is no continuous wavefunction to collapse, so the measurement problem is solved trivially.

sources.quote: In this sense, the measurement problem is rather trivially solved in IST.
the measurement problem is trivially solved in terms of a nonlinear clustering of states in state space
